No hidden dotfiles under environment/. 'Nothing that secretly needs an install' (Internal sheet): solution/app/package.json depends only on express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1, exactly the versions installed globally by Dockerfile:9-12; server.js requires only crypto/fs/path/express/better-sqlite3; solve.sh only copies files (no install). Runtime: golden-run.log (sha 4da6ab5d... matches index) shows the frozen solution started under env -i with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules as uid 65534 in cw-editor-agent-r3 and ended 'exit 0' with checks PASS, i.e. deps resolve from the image without any install; docker history of cw-editor-agent-r3 shows the same template layers (apt ca-certificates git procps sqlite3; npm -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1). 2 CPUs / 4 GB is ample for a single Express+SQLite process plus agent tooling. Counterexample probes: a conforming agent app choosing other npm packages would install them into /app at agent time over the public network and /app is an artifact, so no unfair failure arises from this row's posture; no broken-app pass route is controlled by this row. Conflict recorded, not flagged: the Internal Quality Checks sheet row 9 still says 'Agent image is no-network', but the client Quality Checks row 9, SKILL.md:26 and quality-checks.md #9 state network is public and must not be flagged; current profile governs. Limits of evidence (run_verdict PARTIAL): the golden run used a pre-existing image cw-editor-agent-r3 built 2026-10-01 from the same Dockerfile text (with older instructions/assets; task assets were bind-mounted) and was not launched with --cpus 2 --memory 4096m, so a fresh build of this frozen environment context and execution under the configured limits were not measured by this reviewer.
